- **Paperback books:** Usually range from **$8 to $20** , depending on the publisher and release date.
- **Hardcover books:** Typically cost **$25 to $30+** for new releases.
- **Used or peer-to-peer copies:** Often available for **$2 to $10** through secondary marketplaces.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/usatodayvideo/videos/as-book-prices-climb-publishers-authors-and-readers-grapple-with-inflation-chang/1668012131149084/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12857820148734661180,catalogid:508029339336427792,gpcid:16695165909218956280,mid:4657621&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:4287797567860555580,catalogid:7400695790023927102,gpcid:12728760204550666775,mid:576462531153706702&ibp=oshop)

### Best Websites to Find and Compare Book Prices

- **General Price Comparison:** BookFinder.com searches dozens of booksellers at once for new, used, rare, and out-of-print editions.[[1]](https://www.bookfinder.com/)
- **Multi-Category Deals:** DealOz helps you compare prices for fiction, non-fiction, and academic titles.[[1]](https://www.dealoz.com/)
- **Book Price Aggregator:** [AllBookstores](https://www.allbookstores.com/) compares online prices to show the lowest available cost and list price savings.[[1]](https://www.allbookstores.com/)
- **Textbook Savings:** [SlugBooks](https://www.slugbooks.com/) compares prices across textbook rental and purchase sites to find cheap student options.[[1]](https://www.slugbooks.com/)
- **Used Peer-to-Peer:** Platforms like [PangoBooks](https://pangobooks.com/) let readers buy and sell second-hand or new copies directly from other people at steep discounts.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12857820148734661180,catalogid:508029339336427792,gpcid:16695165909218956280,mid:4657621&ibp=oshop)
